note:
The room is in writing: The writer you picked writes the whole script.

Drawability: Pages are drawn by an image model, one page per generation, from each character's and location's sheet, and a page drifts when it carries too much. So: at most 4 panels a page; at most 3 named characters in one panel; one location a page where the story allows (every new location needs its own sheet); no crowd that must be recognisable; a big moment gets a splash (one panel, the whole page). Count pages this way, not by comic convention. Every page you make keeps to it.

draft-final.md is the book: the showrunner's draft, edited to the canon and expanded, and approved. Script it, and do nothing else: break it into pages and panels, one page after another in its order, with panel descriptions an artist can draw and a balloon for each of its lines, word for word. No new beats, no new dialogue, nothing cut, nothing moved; [NEW] marks are the editor's and are not printed. Where there is no draft-final.md, script draft.md the same way. End each page's PAGE CHECK with `CHANGED: none`, or what you had to change to draw it and why. Continuity Editor: check script.md against draft-final.md. A dropped, merged or reordered beat, a line not word for word, or anything added that the draft does not have is a Blocker.

The book is exactly 12 pages: pages 1-12, no more, no fewer.

Showrunner's note for this round: Chapter 1, 12 pages, from the showrunner's draft in drafts/. Edit it; do not rewrite it.
